title: Etale/pro-etale inverse-image square commutes with derived scalar comparison
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $a:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of discrete commutative rings. Use constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and ordinary unbounded derived module categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For $R=A,B$, $Z=X,Y$ and $t=e,p$ denoting the etale and pro-etale sites, write $C_Z^R=\nu_Z^*$ for comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $l_R=f_{\mathrm{et},R}^*$ and $p_R=f_{\mathrm{proet},R}^*$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and $T_Z^t=B_Z\otimes^L_{A_Z}-$ for scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $d_R:p_RC_Y^R\xrightarrow{\sim}C_X^Rl_R$ be the canonical inverse-image square of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison]. Let $c^e:l_BT_Y^e\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^el_A$ be the K-flat-normalized comparison [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso], and let $c^p:p_BT_Y^p\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^pp_A$ and $\delta_Z:T_Z^pC_Z^A\xrightarrow{\sim}C_Z^BT_Z^e$ be the canonical ringed pullback/scalar comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Then, for every $M\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$\delta_{X,l_AM}\circ T_X^p(d_{A,M})\circ c^p_{C_Y^AM}=C_X^B(c^e_M)\circ d_{B,T_Y^eM}\circ p_B(\delta_{Y,M}).$$
Both sides are morphisms $p_BT_Y^pC_Y^AM\to C_X^BT_X^el_AM$. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, boundedness or flatness of $a$ is assumed.
